discrete_moment.formula: G_discrete=15*G_input * sum(h*rx^2*rz^2/r^3)/sum(h*r); full symmetric122-neighbor cubic stencil, fixed weighted volume, infinitesimal affine shear used only for analytical quadrature diagnostic
discrete_moment.scope: This is not a free-interior material experiment or a convergence study. It predicts the leading quadrature response of a full neighborhood, to be compared against the actual M2P result.
discrete_moment.method: Taylor expansion of the unchanged independently validated LPS potential; no all-node prescribed time integration

shear.interpretation: Free-surface/grip-induced heterogeneous field and global-traction/local-strain mismatch are major causes. Original force conversion, area and symmetric shear-strain formula reproduced. Periodic residual to940 assessed against frozen cubic-stencil fourth moment, not eliminated by parameter tuning.
shear.internal_consistency: M1/M2/M3P values cannot be assembled as one isotropic calibrated material tensor; finite boundaries, measurement fields and cubic quadrature differ.

kinematic_protocol_limit.derivation: In M5B, any vertical bond with both endpoints in a prescribed collar has |delta_z|=(1+epsilon_nominal)*r0. Hence stretch>=epsilon_nominal regardless of transverse response. Its stretch necessarily exceeds s00 at imposed epsilon=.15; no threshold exemption is allowed.
kinematic_protocol_limit.interpretation: Full fixed-duration data will be retained. Later prescribed-collar rupture cannot be interpreted as free specimen fracture energy or successful localization. No retrospective shortening or extra alternative specimen; evaluate first/early crack competition and disclose forced late collar damage.

early_before_forced_collar.selection: Latest predeclared1ms accepted snapshot strictly before analytically forced collar-break threshold; no interpolated state or new stopping time

notch.reason: Initiation can improve while finite-band fragmentation, uncertain new surface and imposed late collar stretching still prevent reliable fracture work per crack area. Signed topology energy is retained without clamping negative increments.
